verses.text: Moses, Yahweh’s servant, had died. Then Yahweh came through with a word for Joshua, son of Nun—Moses’ assistant: 🗣️
‘Moses my servant is gone. Now get up, cross the Jordan with everyone here, and step into the land I’m giving Israel. 🌊
‘Every place your feet touch? I’ve handed it to you, just like I promised Moses. 👣
‘Here’s the territory: from the wilderness and Lebanon to the great Euphrates River—including all the Hittite land—and west to the Great Sea. 🗺️
‘Nobody will be able to stand against you for as long as you live. I was with Moses, and I’m with you too. I won’t bail on you or leave you hanging. 🤝
‘Stay strong and brave—you’re leading these people into the land I swore to their ancestors. You’ve got this. 💪
‘But be extra strong and brave. Stick close to all the law my servant Moses commanded you. Don’t drift left or right; stay on track, and you’ll move wisely wherever you go. 📜
‘Keep this law book on your lips. Run it through your mind day and night, then do what it says. That’s how your way forward will prosper and you’ll know how to move. 📖
‘Didn’t I tell you? Be strong and brave. Don’t panic or fold—Yahweh your God is with you everywhere you go.’ 🛡️
Then Joshua called up the people’s officers and gave them their next move: 📣
‘Go through the camp and tell everyone: “Get your food ready. In three days we cross the Jordan and take possession of the land Yahweh your God is giving you.”’ 🍞
Joshua had a word for the Reubenites, the Gadites, and half the tribe of Manasseh: 🗣️
‘Remember what Moses, Yahweh’s servant, told you: “Yahweh your God is giving you rest and has handed you this land. 🏡
‘“Your wives, kids, and livestock can stay in the land Moses gave you east of the Jordan. But your fighting men need to gear up, cross ahead of your fellow Israelites, and help them, 🛡️

‘“until Yahweh gives your fellow Israelites rest too and they take possession of the land he’s giving them. Then you can head back to your own land east of the Jordan—the land Moses, Yahweh’s servant, gave you.”’ 🤝
They answered Joshua, ‘We’ll do what you tell us and go wherever you send us. We’re in. ✅
‘We listened to Moses, and we’ll listen to you too. May Yahweh your God stay with you like he stayed with Moses. 🙏
‘Anyone who rebels against your command and refuses your words must be put to death. Just stay strong and brave.’ ⚠️
